[[Wydad Casablanca]] came into the season as defending champions of the [[2021–22 Botola|2021–22 season]]. [[Moghreb Tétouan]] and [[Union de Touarga]] entered as the two promoted teams from the [[2021–22 Botola 2]]. On June 23, 2023, [[AS FAR (football)|AS FAR]] won the Botola Pro after a 2–3 victory against [[IR Tangier|Ittihad Tanger]] in the last round. The [[AS FAR (football)|AS FAR]] club won its 13th title after fifteen years since the last time in 2007–08.{{Cite news|url=https://site.frmf.ma/%d8%aa%d9%87%d9%86%d8%a6%d8%a9-29/|title=تهنئة
